label: Reading relations from two sequences
subgoals: Mark a left of b when a precedes b in both sequences
Mark a below b when a follows b in the first and precedes it in the second

label: Packing by longest paths
subgoals: Build horizontal edges weighted by widths and vertical edges weighted by heights
Process blocks in the order of the second sequence
Take the longest path to each block as its coordinate

label: Annealing over sequence pairs
subgoals: Perturb by swapping blocks in one or both sequences or rotating a block
Re-pack and score area, outline violation and wirelength
Use a longest-common-subsequence packer to cut evaluation cost
